features: [IN QUEST FOR THE “ONE”] : Tapping foot on to your favourite beats becoming an issue? We got your back with our sleek 20W audio genius and compact wireless bluetooth speaker Sound Drum P. The one and only solution to your portable speaker worries!

[IN-BUILT MIC FOR HANDSFREE CALLING] : Make things easier than ever before with making calls, a handsfree job! The wireless bluetooth speaker comes with a dedicated and a highly receptive microphone that allows for distortion free and lucid calls!

[BLUETOOTH ENHANCED SOUND BEAST] : The gadget that you never knew you needed, Sound Drum P is going to change the way you listen to music or any sound! With its smart bluetooth interface, seamless connectivity is a plus!

[USB SLOT FOR ADDITIONAL CONNECTIVITY OPTIONS] : In case you have a USB drive that needs some marathon, Sound Drum P would be it’s holy grail! Just port in and enjoy your favourite playlists over and over!

[4000 MAH HEAVY DUTY BATTERY] : Sound Drum P will give many 20W bluetooth speakers a run for their money with its long standing 4000mAh Li-ion battery. Just charge up the speaker and flourish on the musical notes!

[AUX IN PORT] : With its AUX In port you can further expand on the compatibility options and play any audio through it. It seamlessly puts out audio that runs out of the source device and finally through the speaker!

[LIGHTWEIGHT DESIGN] : An easy to carry speaker, you will be surprised by Sound Drum P and its portability! Made out of lightweight materials, Sound Drum P fits any and every space, the best part is you can carry it anywhere!

[TYPE-C CHARGING] : Since we love to stay upbeat with new technological upgrades, Sound Drum P stays ahead on this instance, with its Type C charging port. This allows for a wide compatibility not only in matters of connectivity but also charging.

[6-7 HOURS OF PLAYTIME] : Stay upbeat with consistent playtime of upto 7 hours on a single charge of upto 45 minutes. Loop through your favourite tracks for as much as you want and blast away with the tunes!
